raisedIn: St. George, Staten Island, New York City
background: Born and raised in St. George, Staten Island, in a Bene Israel Jewish family; one parent is a pharmacist and the other manages a city laboratory, and she grew up commuting across boroughs to a small congregation.
regionalHistory: Family stories trace village roots along the Konkan coast, Marathi melodies, and a post-1965 move that joined relatives already in New York.
culturalBaseline: Conservative-leaning and proudly Indian Jewish; Shabbat, Marathi songs, and a questioning relationship to ritual coexist.
sensitivities: Indian Jews treated as a novelty
Jewishness measured only by Ashkenazi customs
